name: services/grades/grade_types
description: Get info about multiple grade types.
brief_description: Get info about multiple grade types.

arguments.name: grade_type_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of grade type IDs.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of grade_type method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your grade_type_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of a grade type, as defined in the grade_type method or null if grade type is not found.
